name: Ourai no Gahkthun: Shining Night
original_name: 黄雷のガクトゥーン：シャイニングナイト
source:
This is the fandisk for Liar-soft’s 2012 steampunk title Ourai no N’gha-Kthun. It takes place a year later in Marseille Floating Academia and follows an omnibus format with over 100 episodes selectable from a map system. More Tesla and Neon for all.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/08/01/august-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
